subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw allow owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in `memory_search` when the configured session visibility would otherwise permit them?
rationale: The remaining bug is real, but the repair changes transcript visibility behavior at a privacy boundary and overlaps an active broader product proposal for private cross-conversation recall.

options.title: Land the targeted live-orphan fix
options.body: Accept a scoped fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 that keeps cross-agent and sandbox-denied hits fail-closed while allowing same-agent owner-scoped live orphan hits.

options.title: Fold into broader private recall
options.body: Resolve this only through the default-off remember-across-private-conversations product surface in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99611 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100140.

options.title: Keep fail-closed
options.body: Continue requiring a session-store key for live transcript hits, preserving the strict boundary but leaving this reported gateway recall gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land the targeted live-orphan fix
recommendation.body: Accept a scoped fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 that keeps cross-agent and sandbox-denied hits fail-closed while allowing same-agent owner-scoped live orphan hits.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the broader active private-recall direction that must align with any targeted session-memory visibility fix.
